paths.description: Public homepage and only discoverable archetype. It represents the entire observable site because the DOM has no links, the manifest is absent, and robots/sitemap provide no valid routes. No auth, form, account, commerce, article, listing, or app paths were available to cover.

findings.summary: The public homepage is completely blank.
findings.evidence: Desktop, mobile, dark-mode, rendered-crawler, and no-JavaScript screenshots are blank. DOM evidence is exactly <html><head></head><body></body></html>, with 0 body characters, headings, links, controls, forms, or landmarks.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish meaningful semantic content with a clear H1, purpose, primary action, navigation where needed, and explicit loading, empty, and error states. Return an authored HTML document rather than a zero-byte body.

findings.summary: The endpoint has no authored theme or high-contrast treatment.
findings.evidence: The dark screenshot remains the same blank white canvas; DOM reports color-scheme: normal and no CSS. Under forced-colors/prefers-contrast there are zero authored controls or text to provide a usable experience.
findings.suggestedFix: Once content exists, declare color-scheme and use system-aware colors/light-dark(); verify all text and controls under prefers-color-scheme, prefers-contrast, and forced-colors.

findings.summary: The document omits the viewport meta tag.
findings.evidence: At an emulated 360x800 viewport Chrome uses a 980 CSS-pixel layout viewport and scale 0.367; DOM, layout, and zoom probes all report hasViewportMeta=false.
findings.suggestedFix: Add <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"> and build content with fluid/intrinsic sizing and reflow-safe components.

findings.summary: The page never paints content, so user-visible load performance cannot succeed.
findings.evidence: Trace recorded null FCP and null LCP. Lighthouse terminated with NO_FCP and produced no category scores, despite loadEventEnd at 218.83 ms.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve actual above-the-fold HTML, then measure field/lab LCP, INP, and CLS and optimize the content-bearing page rather than treating a zero-byte response as fast.

findings.summary: There is no accessible document structure or legible content.
findings.evidence: The structure probe finds 0 headings, 0 landmarks, 0 focusable controls, no lang, and no body text. This gives keyboard and assistive-technology users no content or task.
findings.suggestedFix: Use semantic landmarks, a logical heading hierarchy, meaningful text, properly named native controls, visible focus, and a valid lang attribute; test with keyboard and assistive technology.

findings.summary: The response is not a sound HTML document.
findings.evidence: The server returns content-type application/octet-stream and content-length 0. Browser reconstruction has no doctype, charset, title, metadata, or authored body.
findings.suggestedFix: Return a valid HTML5 document as text/html; charset=utf-8 with <!doctype html>, <html lang>, charset and viewport metadata, a meaningful head, and semantic body content.

findings.summary: The homepage has no search or share metadata and no crawlable content.
findings.evidence: Rendered and raw HTML both contain zero content tokens; title is empty, H1 count is 0, meta description is absent, and there are no links or JSON-LD/Open Graph fields.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a unique title, concise meta description, canonical URL, useful crawlable links, visible H1/content, and accurate Open Graph/structured data for the entity represented.

findings.summary: Indexing discovery endpoints are placeholders rather than valid indexing signals.
findings.evidence: /robots.txt and /sitemap.xml both return HTTP 200 with the literal body "empty OK"; sitemap.xml is not XML and the page has no canonical or robots metadata.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve a syntactically valid robots.txt and XML sitemap containing canonical public URLs; add canonical metadata and keep indexing policy consistent.

findings.summary: Important browser security policies are missing or ineffective.
findings.evidence: HTTPS is used and nosniff is present, but curl shows HSTS max-age=1 second. CSP, clickjacking protection, Referrer-Policy, and Permissions-Policy are absent; the header primitive independently flags the missing policy set.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a tested CSP (including frame-ancestors), durable HSTS after rollout validation, Referrer-Policy, and a least-privilege Permissions-Policy. Preserve nosniff.

findings.summary: A successful request yields an unexplained blank state with no recovery path.
findings.evidence: HTTP 200 returns zero bytes and the browser renders an empty body. There is no loading, empty, error, retry, back, or support action, so users cannot distinguish failure from intended state.
findings.suggestedFix: Return meaningful content for success and explicit, actionable empty/error responses for failures, with retry or navigation recovery and appropriate HTTP status codes.
